jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Our Mission:

6sense’s mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

6sense is hiring a Senior Digital Program Manager to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform.Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

What This Role Is – And Isn’t

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

  • You move fast and ship. Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
  • You lead, not just execute. You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
  • You flag blockers immediately. Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
  • You own your backlog. You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
  • You know the difference between “I need input” and “I need permission.” Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Program Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
  • Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
  • Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
  • Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
  • Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

Digital Journey & Campaign Build

  • Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
  • Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
  • Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
  • A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis

  • Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
  • Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
  • Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

Gainsight Platform Leader

  • Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
  • Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
  • Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

Reporting, Analytics & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
  • Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
  • Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

CS Ops & Leadership Partnership

  • Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
  • Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
  • Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
  • Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey Orchestrator programs and email campaigns from strategy through measurement.
  • Demonstrated program or project leadership: you have owned cross-functional initiatives and delivered measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of the Gainsight data model – MDA, relationships, connectors, and Rules Engine.
  • Experience with Snowflake-to-Gainsight data ingestion, including connector setup, MDA mapping, and pipeline troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce integrations and how Gainsight syncs with SFDC, Snowflake, and other data providers.
  • Experience using data to identify engagement gaps and turn them into prioritized programs.
  • Working knowledge of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and health scoring in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver without oversight.
  • Track record of fast execution: you have built dashboards in a day and launched journeys in a week.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with executive presence and the ability to document for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

  • Gainsight Admin certification.
  • Experience with health scoring model design and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with Pendo, including building in-app guides and messaging, defining behavioral segments, analyzing product usage and adoption, and using insights to trigger targeted digital CS journeys
  • Experience using Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and Workato to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and scale digital CS programs.
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, in-app messaging, or digital customer success programs at scale.
  • Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools; familiarity with SQL.
  • Experience in a commercial or mid-market CS motion supporting a large, digitally served customer base.

What Success Looks Like

First 15 days: The Gainsight digital programs have been reviewed and the backlog is prioritized and agreed with CS Ops and CS Leadership. An initial engagement coverage baseline for the commercial book shows where customers are and are not being reached. Quick-win deliverables are shipped (dashboards, segments, reports), and at least one digital journey is live in production.

Within 30 days: Existing journeys have been updated and new programs are being launched. Full program and campaign calendar is underway. A strategic program roadmap for the Commercial book is reviewed and approved by CS Leadership. Performance and gap reporting is in place and stakeholders are reviewing results.

Within 45 days: Engagement gaps prioritized by CS Leadership have programs in market, with measurable movement in reach and engagement. A recurring cadence for program review and gap reporting is established, and digital and CSM-led motions are connected through CTAs and plays.

Base Salary Range: $92,812.50 - $136,125.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Ads powers one of the industry’s leading retail media networks, helping brands, CPGs, and retailer partners reach shoppers with relevant, effective advertising across the Instacart platform. As part of the Ad Product team, you’ll own the Formats domain, where we place 0→1 bets that fuel double-digit growth for Ads and keep CPGs and new advertiser types engaged.

You’ll sit at the intersection of CPGs, retailers, and customers, shaping new ad experiences across multiple user-facing surfaces. Your portfolio spans new advertiser, formats innovation, and in-store experiences. You’ll partner closely with XFN stakeholders, our Online Grocery team, and external technology partners.  If you’re energized by taking ambiguous ideas from zero to one, fluent in ad formats and user experience, and comfortable managing partners and vendors, this is the role for you.

About the Job

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Invoicing
jobs.jd_full:
Every business needs to get paid. For many of the startups and small businesses that bank with Mercury, that starts with sending an invoice. The process has to be effortless. A polished, professional invoice should take seconds to create. Customers should be able to pay easily. Once the payment arrives, it should match itself to the right invoice without anyone lifting a finger.

Mercury Invoicing is a fast-growing product serving customers across Technology, Professional Services, Real Estate, and more. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to take a product that already works and make it even more powerful.

You’ll own the full Invoicing experience: the dashboard where businesses track what they’re owed, the builder where they create invoices, and the payer experience on the other side. You’ll work closely with the PM who built Invoicing from scratch and now leads adjacent efforts. Together, you’ll decide how Invoicing grows to meet more complex customer needs without losing the simplicity that made customers choose it in the first place.

* Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the roadmap for Mercury Invoicing across every surface: the dashboard, the builder and the payer experience
  • Talk to customers and prospects, and turn what you hear into clear next steps
  • Take on a full backlog of work we already know customers need: accounting integrations, invoice templates, credits and credit memos, promos and coupons .. the list goes on
  • Keep the product simple while making it more powerful, so it grows with customers as their businesses scale
  • Find where AI can make getting paid meaningfully better, without chasing hype
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design and Data Science, as well as Product Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Risk and other product teams like Mercury Books
  • Grow the business, measured by Invoicing’s active users, new feature adoption, and customer retention

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience building and shipping products, ideally ones where money moves and mistakes are costly
  • Strong product judgment: you can take a full backlog, decide what matters most and explain why
  • A passion for talking to customers, and a record of turning their feedback into products they love
  • Close attention to detail. Invoices are money, and small details matter to the businesses sending them and to the people paying them.
  • High agency and comfort owning a product end to end, from problem definition to launch and iteration
  • Strong partnership with engineering and design, and the ability to align many cross-functional stakeholders behind one plan
  • The ability to learn a new domain quickly

It would be particularly useful if you have:

  • Experience at a company that serves startups and/or small businesses

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation’s most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 1651

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Remote

Clearance Level: Public Trust, Must Have Ability to Obtain a Clearance

Required Certification(s): PMP

Job Description

Under general oversight of a program manager, oversees multiple technical/scientific projects or one larger project. In addition to duties of Project Manager I, builds and maintains working relationships with vendors, and other departments involved in the projects, and may have some customer contact. Prepares reports for upper management regarding status of project.

Function-specific level guidelines:  Provides innovative solutions to complex problems that impact project’s success. Normally has a Bachelor’s degree in a related scientific or technical discipline. May have a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or is pursuing one.

Education and Background

Typically has a Bachelor’s degree, and 9 - 11 years of experience, or equivalent relevant work experience; e.g., each year of work experience may be substituted for each year of education required.

Years of Experience

9 - 11 years

Required Skills

Technical Expertise

1.     Agile Methodology Expertise:

  • Proficient in Agile frameworks such as SAFe, Scrum, DevSecOps, and Lean Agile.
  • Experience managing Agile Release Trains and leading Agile teams.
  • Ability to oversee backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and program increments.

2.    Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Knowledge:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects through all SDLC phases, including concept definition, design, execution, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning.
  • Familiarity with TSA Systems Engineering Lifecycle (SELC) processes and gate reviews.

3.    Risk Management:

  • Skilled in developing, maintaining, and implementing risk management plans, including risk identification, mitigation, and monitoring.
  • Ability to manage technical risks, ensure timely escalation, and coordinate risk resolution.

4.    Performance Metrics Management:

  • Ability to use Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools to track metrics like defect closure rates, sprint velocity, and system performance.
  • Proficient in analyzing and reporting on key performance metrics (KPPs) and quality assurance metrics.

5.    Cybersecurity Knowledge:

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity processes, including POA&M resolution and compliance with DHS IT security standards.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability scanning, risk assessments, and contingency plans for IT systems.

Program Management Expertise

6.    Strategic Planning:

  • Experience developing and maintaining Program Management Plans (PMPs) that align with organizational goals, tactical roadmaps, and technical strategy.
  • Ability to plan and track budgets, resource allocation, and schedules.

7.    Stakeholder Communication:

  • Strong communication skills to maintain effective coordination with TSA leadership, other contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and maintaining communication plans, including RACI matrices.

8.    Team Leadership:

  • Skilled in managing cross-functional teams, including federal employees, contractors, and external vendors.
  • Ability to foster collaboration across diverse project teams to achieve shared goals.

9.    Transition Management:

  • Experience managing transition-in and transition-out phases for government contracts.
  • Ability to develop and implement staffing plans, risk management approaches, and transition project schedules.

10.    Scheduling and Resource Management:

  • Proficient in MS Project or similar tools for developing resource-loaded, resource-leveled project schedules.
  • Ability to manage both steady-state operations and fluctuating workloads.

Operational Oversight

11.    Quality Assurance:

  • Proven ability to implement and maintain Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs) and Quality Control Plans (QCPs).
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure deliverables are accurate, complete, and client-ready.

12.    Incident Management:

  • Experience handling critical incident management and root cause analysis to resolve system outages and disruptions.
  • Ability to coordinate with infrastructure contractors to identify and address issues.

13.    System and Application Support:

  • Knowledge of operations and maintenance (O&M) processes, including Tier 3 support and application-level troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for application performance and system interfaces.

Documentation and Reporting

14.    Deliverables Management:

  • Ability to ensure timely submission of deliverables, such as design documents, test plans, risk registers, and transition plans.
  • Experience tracking and reporting on program status, metrics, and burn rates.

15.    Compliance and Accessibility:

  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility standards and ability to ensure compliance in ICT deliverables.

Soft Skills

16.    Problem-Solving Skills:

  • Ability to proactively identify and resolve challenges, including technical and operational issues.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess program performance and recommend improvements.

17.    Leadership and Decision-Making:

  • Demonstrated leader

Preferred Skills

Preferred Certifications

1.    Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

2.    Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Agile certifications.

3.    SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Program Consultant (SPC) certifications.

4.    Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) for cybersecurity expertise.

5.    ITIL Foundation Certification for IT service management

Working Conditions

Virtual. managing a driven Agile team.

$160,000 - $175,000 a year

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It’s how we show up every day. It’s who we are.

  • Happy- Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
  • Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
  • Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
  • Hungry- Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
  • Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

jobs.jd_full:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn’t just a job, it’s an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients.  Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager, for a project-based assignment, you’ll be responsible for overseeing the development and lifecycle of the client’s product, a platform dedicated to combating online disinformation. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to define the product vision, prioritize features, and manage the roadmap. This is a high-impact role ideal for someone who thrives in agile environments and is passionate about purpose-driven innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with the leadership team to develop and execute the Artemis product vision and strategy.
  • Analyze market trends, perform competitor analysis and research, and understand client needs to drive the product roadmap and pricing strategy.
  • Clearly articulate the business value of the features on the roadmap and ensure alignment across the leadership team, the technology teams and the analysis team.
  • Prioritize features on the roadmap by assessing the value to clients and their alignment with the broader product strategy and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to create epics and define product requirements, including functional requirements and user experience.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback and insights, using this knowledge to inform product decisions and enhancements.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends and emerging technologies related to disinformation and online information ecosystems.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in a product management role responsible for cloud-based web applications.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and launching features and products, with a track record of delivering on-time, high-quality products that meet user needs.
  • Passion for the mission of combating disinformation and promoting online safety and integrity.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment using agile development tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating epics and stories for engineering and effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and creatively, with solid problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Experience with prototyping, wireframing, and UI/UX design and collaboration tools such as Figma.

Preferred:

  • Passion for the mission of combating disinformation and promoting online safety.

  • Collaborative and mission-driven team culture
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful, socially-driven technology
